The '''''Praetor''-class Star Battlecruiser''', also known as the '''''Praetor''-class battlecruiser''' or the '''''Praetor''-class battle cruiser''', was a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] produced by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] in the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A four-thousand-meter [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]], the ''Praetor''-class was the successor of the [[Procurator-class Star Battlecruiser|''Procurator''-class Star Battlecruiser]], though both were restricted in terms of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] capability and armament due to the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the ''[[Quaestor]]'' was one of several ''Praetor''-class battlecruisers that received additional armor and weaponry before leading strikes deep into [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space; the ''Quaestor'' was destroyed at [[Destruction of Pammant|Pammant]] when it suffered a hyperdrive mishap due to sabotage and crashed into the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. This crash also fractured the planet. After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the ''Praetor''-class battlecruiser [[Battalion (Praetor-class)|''Battalion'']] hunted Separatist remnant forces, participated in the conflict known as the [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection]] and helped destroy a faction at [[Trasemene]].<ref name="Warfare" /> While stationed in the [[Dalchon sector/Legends|Dalchon sector]], the ship's commander, [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]], had grown disenfranchised with the Empire and defected from military service with a loyal crew. To cover their escape, Tallon arranged to have the ''Battalion'' be destroyed by his friend, the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] captain [[Quist (pirate)|Quist]], in a mock rescue attempt of a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] under attack by pirates.<ref name="Tatooine Manhunt">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref>

The ''Praetor''-class was eventually succeeded by the [[Praetor Mark II-class battlecruiser|''Praetor Mark II''-class battlecruiser]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Unidentified Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser|derelict ''Praetor'']] was cannibalized by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces and its reactors were installed on the frozen planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] to power the facilities of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], including its defensive systems.<ref name="Rebellion">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Praetor''-class battlecruiser was first mentioned in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''. The [[2012]] reference guide ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' retconned the ''Quaestor'', from ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]'', and the ''Battalion'', from the [[West End Games]] roleplaying adventure ''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]'', as ''Praetor''-class battlecruisers.
